question: Should OpenClaw add a public persisted root/trace contract for spawned session chains, and if so should traceId be a new session-chain id or bridge existing diagnostic trace context?
rationale: The code change is bounded, but rootSessionKey and traceId would become public session/Gateway contract fields and need maintainer intent before another automatic implementation attempt.

options.title: Add minimal spawn-chain contract
options.body: Add optional parentSessionKey, rootSessionKey, traceId, and spawnDepth semantics for spawned sessions only, with additive API/docs/tests and no traversal API yet.

options.title: Defer to resolver lineage work
options.body: Keep this open until the session resolve/family lineage direction is settled, then align spawn-chain fields with that contract.

options.title: Reject root/trace as core API
options.body: Keep current parent/depth behavior and close or narrow this request to documentation/tooling if maintainers do not want a new durable chain identifier.

recommendation.title: Add minimal spawn-chain contract
recommendation.body: Add optional parentSessionKey, rootSessionKey, traceId, and spawnDepth semantics for spawned sessions only, with additive API/docs/tests and no traversal API yet.

likelyOwner.reason: He already gave maintainer triage on this issue and merged adjacent ACP lineage contract work.
